name: Wasteland Radio
source:
Enter the town of New Amarillo, Texas more than a century after the end of the world, meet the staff of the town's local radio station, and become WRTX's newest unpaid intern.  Do you have what it takes? Enjoy 30-40 minutes of a fully voiced narrative introducing you to the characters of Wasteland Radio.  Based on the Wasteland Radio podcast.

[From [url=https://noirtoony-games.itch.io/wasteland-radio]Itch.io[/url]]
